title: Sheinbaum Expresses Her Joy Over Lula’s Electoral Triumph in Brazil; “It Is a Breath of Fresh Air for Latin America”
author: Alonso Urrutia and Lilian Hernández
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Lilian
Hernández](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Lilian%20Hern%C3%A1ndez)
originally appeared in the [October 26, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/26/politica/sheinbaum-
expresa-su-alegria-por-el-triunfo-electoral-de-lula-en-brasil-es-una-bocanada-
de-aire-fresco-para-america-latina), Mexico's premier left wing daily
newspaper._

**Mexico City**. President Claudia Sheinbaum expressed her satisfaction at the
**victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the runoff of Brazil 's presidential
elections** held this Sunday.

The president stated, at the start of her press conference and without being
asked:

> We are very happy about Lula's triumph in Brazil. Many congratulations. This
> represents a breath of fresh air for all of Latin America.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

The day before, Sheinbaum had already issued a message on social media that
was very eloquent about her satisfaction with the victory of Lula, who **in
the first round of the presidential election had been defeated by the right-
wing candidate, Flavio Bolsonaro**.
